ink.name: Midnight Black
ink.usage: Default for all body copy, headings, borders. Never substitute for pure #000000.

paper.name: Parchment Cream
paper.usage: Default background of every surface. Always textured with paper grain.

paperLight.name: Parchment Cream — Light
paperLight.usage: Alternate sections on long pages. Use when stacking two textured surfaces.

white.name: Pure White
white.usage: Reserved for card surfaces on paper background. Never a page background.

orange.name: Bitcoin Orange
orange.usage: Use sparingly. Only for: buttons, links on hover, accent rules, highlighted words in quotes. Never for body text.

orangeDeep.name: Bitcoin Orange — Deep
orangeDeep.usage: Hover state for orange buttons and links.

stone.name: Warm Stone
stone.usage: Captions, eyebrows, supporting metadata. Never for primary copy.

stoneSoft.name: Warm Stone — Soft
stoneSoft.usage: Soft rules, placeholder backgrounds before photos load.

charcoal.name: Charcoal
charcoal.usage: Paragraph copy. Softer than pure ink for long-form readability.

rules: Never use Bitcoin Orange on Parchment Cream at text sizes (fails WCAG). Use ink or charcoal.
Never set the background to pure white at the page level. Paper or Paper Light only.
Never use more than one orange accent in a single viewport section.
Photography must always be grayscale with contrast 1.06×. No color photos.
